Class_Skill_Desc_Occult Elixir: Consume an Occult Elixir to completely restore HP and MP of self and nearby party members.</br>Can only be executed while you possess an Occult Elixir.
Class_Skill_Desc_Occult Ether: Consume an Occult Potion to completely restore MP of self or target.</br>Can only be executed while you possess an Occult Potion.
Class_Skill_Desc_Occult Potion: Consume an Occult Potion to completely restore HP of self or target.</br>Can only be executed while you possess an Occult Potion.
Class_Skill_Desc_Revive: Resurrects target to a weakened state.</br>Can also be cast on targets with Resurrection Restriction.
